shots.say: Can little Clover lead the big sheep home? Look! The sun is going down. But the sheep just munch, and munch!
shots.tag: hook: Clover and the munching flock

shots.say: The Animated Zoo!
Hello, I'm Milo! Today I am visiting Clover the lamb, on the sunny farm.
It is almost supper time! Today, I want to lead the flock home. All by myself!
shots.tag: Clover: I want to lead the flock home

shots.say: The flock is up in the meadow, little one. Walk them home, before the sun goes down.
shots.tag: Mama: walk them home before sunset

shots.say: I can do it, Mama! I am a big lamb now!
Who wants to lead the flock home? Clover, or Milo?
Sheep live together, in a big group. It is called a flock.
shots.tag: fact: sheep live in a flock

shots.say: What is a group of sheep called? A flock, or a sock?
Clover and Milo skip up the hill, to the green meadow. And there is the flock!
shots.tag: the meadow: there is the flock

shots.say: Count the big sheep with Milo! One, two, three!
Here are Woolly, Daisy, and Bramble. They are very busy. Munch, munch, munch!
Time to go home, everyone! Baa! Baa!
shots.tag: Clover calls: time to go home

shots.say: But Clover's voice is very little. The big sheep do not look up. Munch, munch, munch.
shots.tag: the sheep do not look up

shots.say: Can you call, like Clover? Baa! Baa!
Sheep eat grass, and other plants. They like to munch all over a wide, green meadow.
shots.tag: fact: sheep eat grass and other plants

shots.say: What do sheep eat? Grass, or cake?
Did the sheep come when Clover called? Yes, or no?
Oh. They did not hear me. I need a new idea.
shots.tag: Clover: I need a new idea

shots.say: So Clover walks behind big Woolly. And she pushes!
shots.tag: Clover walks behind Woolly and pushes

shots.say: Push, push, push! Please move, Woolly!
But Woolly is big, and Clover is small. Woolly does not move one bit.
Can you push, like Clover? Push, push, push!
Did Woolly move? Yes, or no?
Oh my! Pushing is too hard for me.
The sun slides lower. Clover has one more idea. She will run around the flock!
shots.tag: the sun is lower: one more idea

shots.say: Round and round I go! Come on, everyone!
Round, and round, and round. But the sheep only watch. And now Clover is dizzy!
shots.tag: the sheep watch, Clover is dizzy

shots.say: How does Clover feel? Dizzy, or sleepy?
Take a big breath with Clover. In, and out.
The sky turns gold. The big sheep are still munching. Clover feels a little sad.
shots.tag: gold sky, Clover a little sad

shots.say: I am too little. Maybe I can not lead the flock home.
shots.tag: Clover: maybe I can not lead the flock

shots.say: It's okay, Clover. I am right here with you.
How does Clover feel now? Sad, or happy?
Then Clover sees something. Daisy walks to a new patch of grass.
And look! Woolly follows Daisy. And Bramble follows Woolly!
What did the other sheep do? Follow, or fly?
I know! Sheep like to follow! I will not push. I will walk first!
shots.tag: Clover's idea: I will walk first

shots.say: Sheep like to follow each other. When one sheep moves, the rest will follow.
shots.tag: fact: when one sheep moves the rest follow

shots.say: When one sheep moves, what do the others do? Follow, or hide?
So Clover lifts her head up high. And she walks. Step, step, step.
Daisy looks up. And she follows Clover! Then Woolly. Then Bramble!
Down the lane they go, in a line. Clover first, and the flock behind her.
shots.tag: the lane: Clover first, the flock behind

shots.say: Count the sheep behind Clover! One, two, three!
Can you march, like Clover? March, march, march!
Follow, follow, one by one. Home together, day is done!
Who is leading the flock? Clover, or Woolly?
Past the fence, and all the way home, to the big red barn. And there is Mama!
Clover! You led the flock home! I am so proud of you.
Inside the cosy barn, supper is ready. Sweet, dry grass for everyone!
Thank you, Milo! You stayed with me the whole time.
You do not have to be big to lead, Clover. You just have to go first.
Do you remember? What is a group of sheep called? A flock, or a sock?
And what do sheep eat? Grass, or rocks?
Follow, follow, one by one. Home together, day is done!
Next time: Clover and the Woolly Haircut! See you on the next adventure, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
